rights.notes: 用户明确要求分析已放好的寒武纪.mkv，并允许调用 ZenMux API 上传发送材料。此记录表示对本场分析与外部处理的授权，不声明核验参与者同意书。具体首个请求由 agent 在该授权内沿用 Gemini 3.7 Flash、完整音轨、一次尝试与 1 美元非硬性估算；没有外部发布授权。

qa.notes: Preparation only; no listening, independent ASR or user acceptance is claimed.
Raw full-audio model response retained; separate local evidence and technical review follows. No independent ASR or human listening review.
Media integrity and two sampled frames checked; no listening, ASR, role or word-level validation.
Local evidence and technical review passed within stated limits. No word-level, exact-timestamp or speaker verification; corrected overstatements and unsupported additions.
Report separates source summaries, technical corrections, suggested exercises and unknowns; user acceptance remains pending.
Verified candidate manifest, current artifact bytes, local links, approximate timestamp bounds and stated limitations. No listening or explicit user acceptance.
ASR preparation only; local protocol is not sent as a prompt.
Transcription response retained. Provider returned no queryable request identifier; receipt is a local SHA-256 response fingerprint, not a provider ID. Zero token counts do not mean a free request.
ASR schema/duration validated; indexed chunks reconstruct the raw text exactly. No acoustic correctness, diarization or exact timestamps are claimed.
Local comparative review; separates agreement, additions, unsupported detail, speaker-attribution inference and transcription uncertainty. Corrects prior local audit where ASR adds evidence.
Reviewable revised report with source-specific corrections and preparation priorities; previous artifacts are preserved, user acceptance pending.
Delivery checks cover bytes, schema, duration, exact text spans, preserved history, model-default dry-run and repository checks; no human acoustic verification or explicit user acceptance.
